days.title: 台北 → 舊金山 → 芝加哥
days.sum: 早上到舊金山，再飛芝加哥，在 O'Hare 機場過夜轉機。
days.sumEn: A morning arrival in San Francisco, then on to Chicago for an overnight connection at O'Hare.

days.title: 芝加哥 → Albany
days.sum: 早班機飛紐約州首府 Albany，下午在 Colonie 的公園散步。接下來兩天待在 Albany 一帶。
days.sumEn: An early flight to Albany, the capital of New York State, and an afternoon walk in a park in Colonie. The next two days were spent around Albany.

days.title: 開車南下紐約市
days.en: The drive down to New York City
days.sum: 沿 87 號州際公路往南開大約 240 公里，傍晚在 Yonkers 的韓國超市買到台南關廟麵。在紐約這幾天住在 Bronx（不標位置）。
days.sumEn: About 240 kilometers south on I-87, with a stop at a Korean supermarket in Yonkers that sells noodles from Guanmiao, Tainan. The base for the New York days was the Bronx (location not marked).

days.title: 華盛頓大橋、中央公園
days.en: The George Washington Bridge and Central Park
days.sum: 從哥倫布圓環走進中央公園，看 Bow Bridge 和草莓園，傍晚到東河邊。
days.sumEn: Into Central Park from Columbus Circle, past Bow Bridge and Strawberry Fields, and over to the East River in the evening.

days.title: 紐澤西、東河渡輪、世貿遺址、史坦頓島渡輪
days.en: New Jersey, the East River ferry, the 9/11 Memorial, and the Staten Island Ferry
days.sum: 早上過華盛頓大橋到紐澤西 Cranford，回曼哈頓後搭渡輪沿東河南下，走華爾街到世貿遺址，傍晚來回史坦頓島渡輪看自由女神。
days.sumEn: Across the George Washington Bridge to Cranford, New Jersey, then back to Manhattan for a ferry down the East River, a walk along Wall Street to the 9/11 Memorial, and a round trip on the Staten Island Ferry past the Statue of Liberty.

days.title: 中央車站、哈林、洋基球場、布魯克林、康尼島、時代廣場
days.en: Grand Central, Harlem, Yankee Stadium, Brooklyn, Coney Island, Times Square
days.sum: 一天跑遍四個區：哈林的阿波羅劇院、Bronx 的洋基球場、皇后區的河岸、布魯克林大橋下和康尼島，最後回到中城。
days.sumEn: Four boroughs in one day: the Apollo in Harlem, Yankee Stadium in the Bronx, the Queens waterfront, Brooklyn Bridge Park and Coney Island, and back to Midtown.

days.title: 帝國大廈、自由女神遊船、唐人街、世貿一號大樓
days.en: Empire State Building, a harbor cruise, Chinatown, One World Observatory
days.sum: 早上上帝國大廈，中午從南街海港搭船繞自由女神，下午逛唐人街，傍晚上世貿一號大樓的觀景台。
days.sumEn: The Empire State Building in the morning, a boat around the Statue of Liberty from South Street Seaport at midday, Chinatown in the afternoon, and One World Observatory in the evening.

days.title: 古根漢美術館、中央公園、自然史博物館
days.en: The Guggenheim, Central Park, and the Museum of Natural History
days.sum: 博物館大道上的古根漢，穿過中央公園，到對面的美國自然史博物館看恐龍和藍鯨。
days.sumEn: The Guggenheim on Museum Mile, across Central Park, and the dinosaurs and the blue whale at the American Museum of Natural History.

days.title: 紐約 → Albany → Worcester → 波士頓
days.sum: 8/31 先開回 Albany，9/1 再往東經過 Worcester 到劍橋。在波士頓這幾天住在劍橋（不標位置）。
days.sumEn: Back to Albany on 8/31, then east through Worcester to Cambridge on 9/1. The base for the Boston days was Cambridge (location not marked).

days.title: 安角：Rockport 與 Gloucester
days.sum: 往北開到海邊的安角，看 Halibut Point 的採石場和大西洋，再到 Gloucester 的漁人紀念碑。
days.sumEn: North to Cape Ann for the old granite quarry and the Atlantic at Halibut Point, then the Fishermen's Memorial in Gloucester.

days.title: 哈佛、Charles 河、科學博物館
days.en: Harvard, the Charles River, and the Museum of Science
days.sum: 早上走哈佛園區，下午沿 Charles 河走，最後到科學博物館。
days.sumEn: Harvard Yard in the morning, a walk along the Charles in the afternoon, and the Museum of Science.

days.title: MIT、哈佛商學院、波士頓公園、自由之路
days.en: MIT, Harvard Business School, the Public Garden, and the Freedom Trail
days.sum: 勞動節。從 MIT 走到哈佛商學院和哈佛廣場，下午到 Brookline 的 Larz Anderson 公園，傍晚走波士頓公園、老市政廳、昆西市場，在港邊看夕陽。
days.sumEn: Labor Day. From MIT to Harvard Business School and Harvard Square, Larz Anderson Park in Brookline in the afternoon, then the Public Garden, Old City Hall, Quincy Market, and sunset on the harbor.

days.title: 波士頓市中心、Back Bay
days.sum: 從南站走到市中心，經過波士頓公園的新雕塑《The Embrace》，沿 Newbury 街到 Copley 廣場和波士頓公共圖書館。
days.sumEn: From South Station through downtown, past the new sculpture The Embrace on the Common, and along Newbury Street to Copley Square and the Boston Public Library.

days.title: Malden
days.sum: 到波士頓北邊的 Malden，華夏文化協會在這裡。
days.sumEn: North of Boston to Malden, home of the Chinese Culture Connection.

days.title: Medford
days.sum: 9/7 傍晚在 Medford 的河邊散步；9/8 留在劍橋。
days.sumEn: An evening walk by the river in Medford on 9/7; 9/8 was a quiet day in Cambridge.

days.title: 波士頓 → Albany：帝國州廣場、州立博物館
days.en: Boston → Albany: Empire State Plaza and the State Museum
days.sum: 開回 Albany，在 Latham 吃午飯，下午逛帝國州廣場和紐約州立博物館。
days.sumEn: Back to Albany, lunch in Latham, and an afternoon at Empire State Plaza and the New York State Museum.

days.title: Albany → 紐約 → 舊金山
days.sum: 開車南下，從 Newark 機場飛舊金山，半夜落地。
days.sumEn: South by car, and a flight from Newark to San Francisco that landed after midnight.

days.title: 舊金山 → 台北
days.sum: 在舊金山國際航廈轉機，搭聯合航空回台灣，9/12 到家。
days.sumEn: A connection in the International Terminal at SFO and a United flight home, arriving 9/12.

stops.note: 從桃園出發飛舊金山。
stops.en: Departure from Taoyuan for San Francisco.

stops.note: 跨過太平洋，落地時還是 8 月 22 日早上。在這裡轉國內線。
stops.en: Across the Pacific and still the morning of August 22. A domestic connection here.

stops.note: 半夜到芝加哥，在機場等早班機。
stops.en: Chicago after midnight, waiting for the morning flight.

photos.cap: 機場的 I ♥ NY 看板
photos.en: The I ♥ NY sign at the airport

stops.note: 早上十點半落地 Albany。
stops.en: Wheels down in Albany at 10:30 a.m.

stops.note: 中午在 Albany 吃中餐。
stops.en: A Chinese lunch in Albany.

stops.note: Colonie 鎮上的大公園，有步道、涼亭和紀念牆。
stops.en: A large town park in Colonie with trails, a pavilion, and a memorial wall.

stops.note: 進紐約市之前，在 Yonkers 的韓國超市看到台南關廟麵。
stops.en: Just outside the city, noodles from Guanmiao, Tainan, on the shelf of a Korean supermarket in Yonkers.

stops.note: 沿 Hudson 河岸南下，經過華盛頓大橋。
stops.en: Down the Hudson, past the George Washington Bridge.

stops.note: 中央公園的西南角。
stops.en: The southwest corner of Central Park.

photos.en: Old apartment houses on Central Park West

stops.note: 從南邊走到湖邊的 Bow Bridge，再到紀念約翰藍儂的草莓園。
stops.en: North to Bow Bridge over the Lake, then Strawberry Fields, the John Lennon memorial.

photos.cap: 對岸的羅斯福島和皇后區
photos.en: Roosevelt Island and Queens across the water

stops.note: 傍晚到上東城的河邊步道。
stops.en: The riverside walk on the Upper East Side in the evening.

stops.note: 一早開車過橋到紐澤西。
stops.en: Over the bridge to New Jersey first thing in the morning.

stops.note: 在 Cranford 的一間倉庫，裡面堆滿一箱箱的書。
stops.en: A warehouse in Cranford stacked with boxes of books.

stops.note: 經過 Secaucus 和 Weehawken，從林肯隧道回曼哈頓。
stops.en: Through Secaucus and Weehawken, and back into Manhattan through the Lincoln Tunnel.

stops.note: 在 Carl Schurz 公園旁的碼頭搭 NYC Ferry。
stops.en: The NYC Ferry from the landing by Carl Schurz Park.

stops.note: 沿東河一路南下，經過聯合國、皇后區大橋，在華爾街碼頭下船。
stops.en: Down the East River past the United Nations and the Queensboro Bridge, off at the Wall Street pier.

stops.note: 金融區的窄街和老大樓。
stops.en: Narrow streets and old towers in the Financial District.

photos.cap: 哥倫比亞大學發源地的牌子
photos.en: A plaque marking where Columbia University began

stops.note: 百老匯大道上的哥德式教堂。
stops.en: The Gothic church on Broadway.

stops.note: 雙子星原址的兩座紀念池，池邊刻著罹難者的名字。
stops.en: Two memorial pools in the footprints of the Twin Towers, with the names of the victims around the edges.

photos.en: Lower Manhattan on the way back

stops.note: 免費的橘色渡輪，來回各二十五分鐘，從船上就看得到自由女神。
stops.en: The free orange ferry, about twenty-five minutes each way, with the Statue of Liberty in view.

stops.note: 從 Bronx 搭北方線火車進城，在中央車站下車。
stops.en: The Metro-North train into the city, arriving at Grand Central.

photos.cap: 人行道上的 Stevie Wonder 名牌
photos.en: Stevie Wonder's plaque on the sidewalk

stops.note: 125 街上的阿波羅劇院，門口人行道上有歷年巨星的名牌。
stops.en: The Apollo on 125th Street, with plaques for its legends set in the sidewalk.

stops.note: 到 Bronx 的洋基球場外面看看。
stops.en: A look at Yankee Stadium in the Bronx.

stops.note: 皇后區長島市的河岸公園，對面就是聯合國和中城。
stops.en: A riverfront park in Long Island City, Queens, facing the United Nations and Midtown.

photos.en: The Brooklyn Bridge and Lower Manhattan

stops.note: 布魯克林大橋和曼哈頓大橋之間的河岸，玻璃屋裡有一座老旋轉木馬。
stops.en: The waterfront between the Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges, with an old carousel in a glass pavilion.

stops.note: 搭地鐵到布魯克林最南端的海灘和遊樂園。
stops.en: The subway to the beach and amusement park at the southern tip of Brooklyn.

stops.zh: 駐紐約台北經濟文化辦事處
stops.sub: Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in New York

photos.en: A floral wall inside the office

stops.note: 回到中城，到台北經濟文化辦事處。
stops.en: Back in Midtown, a stop at the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office.

stops.note: 傍晚的時代廣場。
stops.en: Times Square in the early evening.

photos.en: A stone lion at the entrance

stops.note: 第五大道上的總館，門口有兩隻石獅。
stops.en: The main branch on Fifth Avenue, guarded by two stone lions.

stops.note: 帝國大廈旁邊的 32 街。
stops.en: West 32nd Street, next to the Empire State Building.

stops.note: 上 86 樓的觀景台，往南看得到下城和自由女神，往北是中城和中央公園。
stops.en: Up to the 86th-floor observatory, with Lower Manhattan and the Statue of Liberty to the south and Midtown and Central Park to the north.

stops.note: 賓州車站上面的體育館。
stops.en: The arena above Penn Station.

photos.en: The seaport and its tall ships

stops.note: 從 16 號碼頭上船。
stops.en: Boarding at Pier 16.

stops.sub: Harbor cruise to the Statue of Liberty

photos.en: The Brooklyn Bridge on the way back

stops.note: 繞過下城南端，在自由島前停下來，再從東河回來。
stops.en: Around the tip of Manhattan, a pause off Liberty Island, and back up the East River.

stops.note: 從勿街一帶走到曼哈頓大橋橋頭，街上看得到中華民國國旗和中文學校。
stops.en: From the area around Mott Street to the foot of the Manhattan Bridge, with Republic of China flags and Chinese schools along the way.

photos.en: The Statue of Liberty in the distance
Three bridges over the East River

stops.note: 西半球最高的大樓，從 100 樓看港口和東河。
stops.en: The tallest building in the Western Hemisphere, with the harbor and the East River below.

stops.note: 世貿遺址旁的交通樞紐，像一副白色的翅膀。
stops.en: The transit hub beside the World Trade Center site, shaped like white wings.

photos.en: A mountain landscape by Van Gogh

stops.note: 萊特設計的螺旋美術館，沿著坡道一路往上看展。
stops.en: Frank Lloyd Wright's spiral museum, seen by walking up the ramp.

stops.note: 沿博物館大道走到大都會博物館門口。
stops.en: Down Museum Mile to the steps of the Met.

stops.note: 穿過公園中段，經過埃及方尖碑和大草坪。
stops.en: Through the middle of the park, past Cleopatra's Needle and the Great Lawn.

stops.note: 恐龍廳、非洲哺乳類的立體造景，最後是海洋生物廳天花板上的藍鯨。
stops.en: The dinosaur halls, the African mammal dioramas, and the blue whale hanging in the Hall of Ocean Life.

stops.note: 9/1 往波士頓的路上，在 Worcester 的麻州藥學與健康科學大學停了一下。
stops.en: On the way to Boston on 9/1, a stop at the Massachusetts College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences in Worcester.

stops.note: Rockport 北端的海岬，以前是花崗岩採石場，現在積滿雨水。
stops.en: The northern tip of Rockport, once a granite quarry, now filled with rainwater.

photos.cap: 刻著罹難漁民名字的碑
photos.en: Tablets with the names of lost fishermen

stops.note: 美國最老的漁港之一，海邊的紀念碑刻著四百年來在海上喪生的漁民。
stops.en: One of the oldest fishing ports in America. The memorial by the harbor lists fishermen lost at sea over four centuries.

stops.note: 回程前在港邊公園看海。
stops.en: A last look at the sea before heading back.

stops.note: 哈佛園和周邊的老建築。
stops.en: Harvard Yard and the old buildings around it.

stops.note: 沿 Charles 河走到划船隊的船屋。
stops.en: Along the Charles to a rowing boathouse.

stops.note: 從河上的橋看波士頓。
stops.en: Boston from a bridge over the river.

stops.note: Charles 河口的科學博物館。
stops.en: The Museum of Science at the mouth of the Charles.

stops.note: 蓋瑞設計的 Stata 中心和像海綿的 Simmons 宿舍。
stops.en: Frank Gehry's Stata Center and the sponge-like Simmons Hall.

stops.note: 走過 Charles 河上的人行橋。
stops.en: Across the footbridge over the Charles.

stops.note: 河的南岸是哈佛商學院。
stops.en: Harvard Business School on the south bank of the river.

stops.note: 從哈佛廣場走進哈佛園，看約翰哈佛像。
stops.en: From Harvard Square into Harvard Yard to see the John Harvard statue.

photos.en: A small temple by the pond

stops.note: Brookline 山丘上的公園，有池塘和社區菜園。
stops.en: A hilltop park in Brookline with a pond and community gardens.

stops.note: 美國第一座公共植物園。
stops.en: The first public botanical garden in the United States.

stops.zh: 自由之路：老市政廳一帶
stops.sub: The Freedom Trail around Old City Hall

photos.en: The gold dome of the State House

photos.cap: 1795 年的 Bell in Hand 酒館

stops.note: 沿著自由之路，從州議會走到老市政廳和舊州議會大樓。
stops.en: Along the Freedom Trail from the State House to Old City Hall and the Old State House.

stops.note: 法尼爾廳旁的老市場。
stops.en: The old market next to Faneuil Hall.

photos.en: A wall of buoys on the wharf

stops.note: 在長碼頭一帶看太陽下山。
stops.en: Sunset around Long Wharf.

photos.cap: 保羅．李維爾故居的牌子

stops.note: 經過北區的保羅．李維爾故居，回到政府中心。
stops.en: Past the Paul Revere House in the North End and back to Government Center.

stops.note: 從南站開始走。
stops.en: Starting out at South Station.

stops.sub: Downtown Crossing and the Theatre District
stops.note: 市中心的商店街和老劇院。
stops.en: The shopping streets and old theaters of downtown.

stops.note: 2023 年初揭幕，紀念金恩博士夫婦在波士頓相遇。
stops.en: Unveiled earlier in 2023 to honor Martin Luther King Jr. and Coretta Scott King, who met in Boston.

stops.note: 再走一次公共花園。
stops.en: Another walk through the Public Garden.

photos.en: Brick row houses in Back Bay

stops.note: Back Bay 的商店街和紅磚排屋。
stops.en: The shops and brick row houses of Back Bay.

stops.zh: Copley 廣場與公共圖書館
stops.sub: Copley Square and the Boston Public Library
stops.note: 廣場兩邊是三一教堂和美國最早的大型公共圖書館。
stops.en: Trinity Church on one side of the square and the first large free public library in America on the other.

stops.note: 下午都在 Malden。
stops.en: The afternoon in Malden.

stops.note: 傍晚在 Medford 的河邊公園散步。
stops.en: An evening walk in a riverside park in Medford.

stops.note: 回到 Albany 一帶，先在 Latham 吃午飯。
stops.en: Back in the Albany area, lunch in Latham first.

stops.note: 州政府大廣場和議會大廈。2025 年再來時，進了議會大廈參觀。
stops.en: The state government plaza and the Capitol. On the 2025 trip, I went inside the Capitol.

photos.cap: 911 當天的紐約消防救護車

photos.en: An old print of the Statue of Liberty

stops.note: 免費的州立博物館，有 911 世貿的展區，也有紐約的老街景。
stops.en: The free state museum, with a World Trade Center gallery and scenes from old New York.

stops.note: 從 Newark 機場搭聯合航空飛舊金山。
stops.en: A United flight from Newark to San Francisco.

stops.note: 半夜一點落地，等到中午轉機回台灣。
stops.en: Landed at 1 a.m. and waited until midday for the flight home.

legs.label: NYC Ferry 東河南下
legs.en: NYC Ferry down the East River

legs.label: → 時代廣場 → 圖書館
legs.en: To Times Square and the library

legs.label: 聯合航空 舊金山 → 桃園
